The ergonomic handle design provides a comfortable grip during cleaning sessions, reducing hand fatigue when washing multiple bottles. The brush head reaches deep into bottles while remaining gentle on surfaces, and the nipple cleaner's compact design navigates tight spaces effectively.

Hygienic Drying and Storage

The included drying rack and base create a dedicated space for air-drying all cleaning tools and baby bottles.
